mapper.sql: FROM adm_charge_item aci -- 就诊 3 张 LEFT JOIN adm_encounter enc ON enc.id = aci.encounter_id AND enc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_patient pat ON pat.id = aci.patient_id AND pat.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_organization org ON org.id = enc.organization_id AND org.is_deleted = 0 -- 产品定义 4 张（def 表可 JOIN，JOIN 条件是 def.id = aci.definition_id） LEFT JOIN adm_charge_item_definition def ON def.id = aci.definition_id AND def.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN wkf_activity_definition wkf ON aci.product_table = 'wkf_activity_definition' AND wkf.id = aci.product_id AND wkf.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition med ON aci.product_table = 'med_medication_definition' AND med.id = aci.product_id AND med.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_device_definition dev ON aci.product_table = 'adm_device_definition' AND dev.id = aci.product_id AND dev.is_deleted = 0 -- 结算对账 2 张（rec 里 bill_date 是筛选核心！charge_item_ids 字符串关联） LEFT JOIN fin_payment_reconciliation rec ON rec.charge_item_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', aci.id, '%') AND rec.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN fin_payment_rec_detail det ON det.reconciliation_id = rec.id AND det.is_deleted = 0 -- 🔴 人员：cashier = rec.enterer_id（跨 whale_users + adm_practitioner 两张表！） LEFT JOIN whale_users cashier ON cashier.id = rec.enterer_id AND cashier.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner prac_cashier ON prac_cashier.id = rec.enterer_id AND prac_cashier.is_deleted = 0 -- 🔴 人员：开单/录入医生 = aci.enterer_id LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner doc ON doc.id = aci.enterer_id AND doc.is_deleted = 0

/* ---------- 💰 金额：从 aci 表直接算（100% 有值，不依赖支付流水）---------- */ CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -aci.base_amount ELSE aci.base_amount END AS baseAmount, CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -aci.discount_amount ELSE aci.discount_amount END AS discountAmount, CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END AS receivableAmount, CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END AS discountedAmount, CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END AS lineAmount

/* ---------- 💰 实收：det 匹配不到 → 兜底 = 行金额（默认全额已收）---------- */ COALESCE(NULLIF( CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) END , 0), CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END) AS actualReceivedAmount, /* ---------- 💰 医保：det.pay_enum='YB' 才分摊，否则 0（无兜底）---------- */ CASE WHEN det.pay_enum = 'YB' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF( CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) END , 0), 0) ELSE 0 END AS insuranceAmount, /* ---------- 💰 自费 = 行金额 - 医保 ---------- */ (CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END) - (CASE WHEN det.pay_enum = 'YB' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF( CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) END , 0), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS selfPayAmount

sql.where:
aci.is_deleted = 0
AND rec.kind_enum = 'OUTPATIENT_CLINIC'
AND aci.tenant_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = #{q.tenantId} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND enc.tenant_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = #{q.tenantId} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND rec.tenant_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = #{q.tenantId} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
AND rec.bill_date >= CONCAT(#{q.dateFrom}, ' 00:00:00')
AND rec.bill_date <= CONCAT(#{q.dateTo}, ' 23:59:59')
AND aci.refund_id IS NULL
AND aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL
AND enc.organization_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CAST(#{q.deptId} AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
AND ( CASE WHEN aci.product_table = 'med_medication_definition' THEN '药品' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN aci.product_table = 'adm_device_definition' THEN '耗材' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN aci.product_table = 'wkf_activity_definition' THEN '医疗服务' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN aci.product_table IS NULL AND aci.generate_source_enum = 'registration' THEN '挂号' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '101%' THEN '挂号' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '100%' THEN '医疗服务' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '200%' THEN '药品' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '3%' THEN '耗材' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ELSE '其他' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci END IN
#{item} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
)
AND ( CASE WHEN aci.product_table = 'med_medication_definition' THEN '药品' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN aci.product_table = 'adm_device_definition' THEN '耗材' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN aci.product_table = 'wkf_activity_definition' THEN '医疗服务' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN aci.product_table IS NULL AND aci.generate_source_enum = 'registration' THEN '挂号' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '101%' THEN '挂号' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '100%' THEN '医疗服务' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '200%' THEN '药品' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHEN def.type_code LIKE '3%' THEN '耗材' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ELSE '其他' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci END IN
#{item} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
)
AND ( enc.bus_no COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.patientKeyword}, '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR pat.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.patientKeyword}, '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci )
AND ( wkf.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.projectName}, '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR med.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.projectName}, '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR dev.name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.projectName}, '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR def.charge_name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.projectName}, '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR (aci.product_table IS NULL AND aci.generate_source_enum = 'registration' AND '挂号费' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.projectName}, '%') COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) )
AND ( wkf.bus_no COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CAST(#{q.internalCode} AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR med.bus_no COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CAST(#{q.internalCode} AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR dev.bus_no COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CAST(#{q.internalCode} AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci )

mapper.select: SELECT -- 1. 原价合计 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -aci.base_amount ELSE aci.base_amount END), 0) AS baseAmountSum, -- 2. 优惠合计 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -aci.discount_amount ELSE aci.discount_amount END), 0) AS discountAmountSum, -- 3. 应收合计 = 原价 - 优惠 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END), 0) AS receivableAmountSum, -- 4. 折后合计 = 原价 - 优惠 COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END), 0) AS discountedAmountSum, -- 5. 行金额合计 = 折后金额 = 原价 - 优惠 -- 🔴 绝对不能用 aci.total_price（= 原价，不是折后！） COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END), 0) AS lineAmountSum, -- 🔴 Bug 1 修复：6. 实收合计 = 每条 aci 分摊实收的 SUM（和明细行算法 100% 一致） -- det 金额是 rec 级总金额，需按 aci 折后比例分摊后再 SUM，避免 N 条重复放大 -- 🔴 兜底：分摊结果 == 0（det 匹配不到支付流水 / rec 内全免）→ 用 lineAmount（行金额折后）兜底，默认全额已收 COALESCE(NULLIF(SUM( CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) END ), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END), 0)) AS actualReceivedAmountSum, -- 🔴 Bug 1 修复：7. 医保合计 = 分摊实收的 SUM（仅 pay_enum='YB'） COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN det.pay_enum = 'YB' THEN (CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) END) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS insuranceAmountSum, -- 🔴 Bug 1 修复：8. 自费合计 = 行金额合计（折后） - 医保合计分摊 SUM（和明细行算法 100% 一致） -- 🔴 说明：actualReceivedAmountSum 有兜底（det没数据=全额已收），但医保合计永远取真实分摊值（没匹配YB=0，自费=行金额） COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) ELSE (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN det.pay_enum = 'YB' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF( CASE WHEN aci.refund_id IS NOT NULL THEN -(CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) ELSE (CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (COALESCE(det.charge_amount, 0) - COALESCE(det.return_amount, 0)) * (aci.base_amount - aci.discount_amount) / (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inner_aci.base_amount - inner_aci.discount_amount), 0) FROM adm_charge_item inner_aci WHERE FIND_IN_SET(inner_aci.id, rec.charge_item_ids)) , 2) END) END , 0), 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS selfPayAmountSum
